info.name: Job Match API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Job Match API — candidates, jobs, and both recommendation directions.

Base URL variable: {{base_url}} — default is http://localhost:5000

Replace {{candidate_id}} and {{job_id}} with real UUIDs after creating records.

variable.description: UUID of a candidate — fill in after POST /candidates
UUID of a job — fill in after POST /jobs

request.description:
Create a new candidate profile.

Required fields: name, expected_salary
Optional fields: summary, years_of_experience, skills[], locations[]
Return all candidate profiles with their skills and locations.
Return a single candidate by UUID. Returns 404 if not found.

Create a new job posting.

Required fields: title, company_name, salary_min, salary_max, remote_allowed
Optional fields: description, min_years_experience, skills[], locations[]

skill_type must be 'must_have' or 'nice_to_have'.
Return all job postings with their skills and locations.
Return a single job posting by UUID. Returns 404 if not found.

item.name: Job → Candidates (recommend candidates for a job)

query.description: Weight for nice-to-have skill score (0–100). All four weights must sum to exactly 100.
Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

request.description:
Given a job ID, return the best-matching candidates ranked by a weighted score.

Hard filter: candidates missing any must-have skill are excluded.

All four weights are required and must sum to exactly 100.

Returns:
- job details
- weights used
- ranked candidates with final score and per-dimension breakdown
- total_results (number of eligible candidates before limit)

item.name: Candidate → Jobs (recommend jobs for a candidate)

query.description: Weight for nice-to-have skill score (0–100). All four weights must sum to exactly 100.
Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

request.description:
Given a candidate ID, return the best-matching jobs ranked by a weighted score.

Hard filter: jobs whose must-have skills the candidate does not possess are excluded.

All four weights are required and must sum to exactly 100.

Returns:
- candidate details (with skills and locations)
- weights used
- ranked jobs with final score and per-dimension breakdown
- total_results (number of eligible jobs before limit)
